inspected: permitted P01, P02, and P03 requests, inputs, outputs, execution logs, manifests, and matching run-bundle trees
P01 and P02 canonical PDFs and page PNGs
reviewer_scope.pass_claim_treatment: Run-log PASS statements were treated as claims, not proof.

evidence_composition.p01: regression run; document algorithm and already-complete command log unchanged by final command-recording clarification
evidence_composition.p02: regression run; document algorithm and already-complete command log unchanged by final command-recording clarification
evidence_composition.p03: fresh run with the final bundle

criteria.evidence: Independent DOCX checks found identical ordered paragraph text and table text, one table in each input/output, unchanged dimensions (P01 74x4; P02 2x2), byte-identical parsed table-external paragraph XML, and identical section XML. The recorded P01 merge signature is unchanged. Actual hashes match the logs and parent verification.

P01 has 5 rendered pages. Every canonical page visibly repeats the complete two-row header. Independent PDF extraction finds exactly 72 unique row IDs in order with page ranges R001-R013, R014-R028, R029-R043, R044-R058, and R059-R072. XML flags only header rows 1-2 as repeating.

P01 pages show intended top and header-bottom rules and the final page shows the bottom rule; no vertical borders, body grid, diagonals, doubles, or table shading are visible. XML confirms 1 pt top, 0.5 pt header-bottom, 1 pt final-bottom rules; all vertical/internal/diagonal borders are nil and fill is white.
All five P01 canonical pages were inspected at original detail. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs, blank continuation page, or excessive row-keep pagination gap was observed.

P01 page 1 keeps the caption with the table start. Page 5 places the note immediately below the final rule and then the NORMAL-END-88421 sentinel. PDF extraction confirms caption on page 1 and note/sentinel on page 5.

P02 explicitly justifies the splitting exception for a single body row taller than one page. XML confirms the repeating header is unsplittable and the body row is splittable. The four-page render preserves all 180 tokens plus the final note and sentinel.

The P02 log limits visual PASS to all four original-resolution pages, which were independently inspected. PDF extraction finds TOKEN-001 through TOKEN-180 exactly once and in order across page ranges 001-044, 045-096, 097-148, and 149-180; the sentinel appears once.

P03 input explicitly identifies an author-information layout container and states its role is title-page layout only. The fresh final-bundle run safely classifies it as not applicable, identifies the required alternative workflow, makes no visual-PASS claim, preserves the expected input hash, and leaves formatted.docx absent.

Each P01/P02/P03 run bundle contains exactly the four manifest-listed files and all hashes match. Independent scans find no checklist.md, __pycache__, cache/log/intermediate file, or standalone F01/F20 semantic token in any bundle.

P01/P02 logs record runtime versions, exact command blocks, input/output hashes, renderer, page count, structural findings, and separate page-specific visual findings. P03 records runtime and each read-only command in full, input hash, no-output reason, and renderer/page-count/visual results as not applicable. All logs disclaim scientific, journal, and full-document certification.
All criteria were decidable from the permitted raw requests, logs, outputs, manifests, structural/hash checks, and nine canonical page images without diagnosis or intended-fix material.

limitations: This review did not re-execute historical P01/P02 authoring commands; their command provenance comes from the supplied logs, while current hashes, structures, bundle state, PDF extraction, and renders were independently checked.

P01 and P02 are regression evidence predating the final command-recording clarification; the task statement says their algorithms and already-complete logs were unchanged. P03 is the fresh final-bundle run.
Visual conclusions apply to the supplied canonical LibreOffice/Poppler renders, not every possible Word renderer.
P03 has no output render by design; its evidence is the documented safety stop, matching input hash, read-only command record, and absence of formatted.docx.
